In this video: Lenin discusses, twelve years before the Russian Revolution was to take hold, how socialists could turn the peasant movement away from the bourgeoisie and help to ensure that the peasants would be more closely aligned with the proletariat and the fight for socialism in the event of future uprisings.

The original text is here: https://www.marxists.org/archive/lenin/works/1905/sep/05e.htm
